<p class="eyebrow">Research Lab · Developing research program</p>

<p class="lab-full-name">Resilient Agricultural Landscapes Decision Lab</p>

How can agricultural landscapes remain productive while protecting water, soil, and ecosystems? REAL Decision Lab connects monitoring landscape change, explaining environmental risk, designing targeted conservation, and learning from outcomes to improve future decisions.

## Current project: Healthy Lake Huron

<div class="current-project"><p class="eyebrow">Active Mitacs Accelerate research · Postdoctoral Scholar</p><h3>Monitoring → Modelling → Indicators → Decisions</h3><p>My current postdoctoral project at the University of Guelph works with the Ausable Bayfield Conservation Authority (ABCA) in the Healthy Lake Huron context. It combines long-term tributary monitoring and high-resolution watershed modelling to explain nutrient and sediment loss, test conservation and climate scenarios, and develop indicators for stewardship and monitoring decisions.</p><ol class="project-sequence"><li>Monitoring records</li><li>Data harmonisation</li><li>Watershed modelling</li><li>Conservation & climate scenarios</li><li>Practical indicators</li><li>Decision support</li></ol><p>The project uses IMWEBs (Integrated Modelling for Watershed Evaluation of BMPs), a process-based watershed model. Here, BMPs are beneficial management practices such as cover crops, buffers, and drainage-water management. Intended outputs include conservation-priority maps, indicator scorecards, and monitoring recommendations.</p><a href="collaboration.qmd#current-applied-collaboration">Read about the applied collaboration →</a></div>

## Methods and research foundations

My established work combines GIS, environmental monitoring, machine learning, and watershed modelling. Earth observation and GeoAI are growing directions. They extend this foundation rather than replace it.

<div class="method-strip"><span>GIS & geostatistics</span><span>Environmental monitoring</span><span>Machine learning</span><span>Process-based modelling</span><span>Earth observation · emerging</span><span>GeoAI · emerging</span><span>Spatial optimisation</span><span>Multi-criteria decision analysis</span></div>

Recent first-authored papers examine field-level conservation prioritisation and alignment with local needs. A separate developing food-system direction explores how early signs of stress can inform timely adaptation.
